HoveredDrawables

Contains all hovered osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawables in top-down order up to the first which returned true in its osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.OnHover(osu.Framework.Input.Events.HoverEvent) method. Top-down in this case means reverse draw order, i.e. the front-most visible osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable first, and osu.Framework.Graphics.Containers.Containers after their children.

public SlimReadOnlyListWrapper<Drawable> HoveredDrawables { get; }

Remarks

This collection should not be retained as a reference. The contents is not stable outside of local usage.

PositionalInputQueue

Contains all osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawables in top-down order which are considered for positional input. This list is the same as osu.Framework.Input.InputManager.HoveredDrawables, only that the return value of osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.OnHover(osu.Framework.Input.Events.HoverEvent) is not taken into account.

public SlimReadOnlyListWrapper<Drawable> PositionalInputQueue { get; }

Methods

ChangeFocus(Drawable)

Changes the currently-focused drawable. First checks that potentialFocusTarget is in a valid state to receive focus, then unfocuses the current osu.Framework.Input.InputManager.FocusedDrawable and focuses potentialFocusTarget. potentialFocusTarget can be null to reset focus. If the given drawable is already focused, nothing happens and no events are fired.

[Obsolete("This method does not allow trapping focus. Use GetContainingFocusManager().ChangeFocus() instead.")]
public bool ChangeFocus(Drawable potentialFocusTarget)

Parameters

potentialFocusTarget Drawable

The drawable to become focused.

Returns

bool

True if the given drawable is now focused (or focus is dropped in the case of a null target).

ChangeFocus(Drawable, InputState)

Changes the currently-focused drawable. First checks that potentialFocusTarget is in a valid state to receive focus, then unfocuses the current osu.Framework.Input.InputManager.FocusedDrawable and focuses potentialFocusTarget. potentialFocusTarget can be null to reset focus. If the given drawable is already focused, nothing happens and no events are fired.

protected bool ChangeFocus(Drawable potentialFocusTarget, InputState state)

Parameters

potentialFocusTarget Drawable

The drawable to become focused.

state InputState

The osu.Framework.Input.States.InputState associated with the focusing event.

Returns

bool

True if the given drawable is now focused (or focus is dropped in the case of a null target).
